items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of the interviewee in relation to Feeder Father. The mention is made by the interviewer stating 'Feeder Father used to play with him' (referring to Tom Albert/Milton Martin), which is a narration of a third-party relationship.

ctx.x: Oh yes. He used to take all the picnics down in Luley Oster. The place we call Luley Oster. Right on by the neighbor station.
Did he live across the river? Yeah he lived across the river. He worked over there most of the time? Yes, that's what he lived. And Feeder Father used to play with him.
And this fellow Cantrell used to play.
